name: nyan-pixel
description: Pixel nyan cat flying in a thin band above the prompt; reacts to errors, tests, commits, edits, skills, the advisor, agents, interrupts, /clear, permissions, context and time of day

height.title: Band height
height.description: Rows of the terminal the band takes.

fps.title: Frames per second
fps.description: 10 halves the work the animation does.

visitors.title: Visitors
visitors.description: How often a UFO, tac nayn or a flock of birds flies by.

holidays.title: Holidays
holidays.description: Confetti on New Year's Day and your birthday, a Santa hat and snow at Christmas, Halloween colours and bats.

idleMinutes.title: Nap after
idleMinutes.description: Minutes with nothing happening before the cat naps on a cloud and the band slows to two frames a second.

birthday.title: Birthday
birthday.description: Your birthday as MM-DD, for a party hat and confetti. Empty: none.
